items.stem:
(a) Why does Mawsynram receive very heavy rainfall while Leh is very dry? (3 marks)
(b) Why does the Tamil Nadu coast remain dry in June–July? (2 marks)
items.answer: (a) (1) Mawsynram lies on the funnel-shaped Khasi hills facing moisture-laden winds from the Bay of Bengal. (2) The winds are forced to rise and shed rain. (3) Leh lies in the rain-shadow of the Himalayas in a cold desert. (b) (1) It lies in the rain-shadow of the Western Ghats for the south-west monsoon. (2) The Bay of Bengal branch moves parallel to its coast.
